title: Perfect complex on the small etale coefficient site
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring in universe $u+1$, $X$ a scheme in universe $u$, and $K\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},R)$ in the ordinary unbounded derived category [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Call $K$ site-perfect if there is an etale cover $\{f_i:U_i\to X\}$ such that each canonical derived inverse image $Lf_i^*K$ [def-kun-projection-formula-map] is isomorphic to $\mathsf QP_i$ for a cochain complex $P_i$ and integers $a_i,b_i$ with $P_i$ strictly zero below $a_i$ and above $b_i$, and with each term $P_i^q$ a retract of the constant sheaf $(R^{m_{i,q}})_{U_i}$ for some natural number $m_{i,q}$. Bounds and ranks may depend on the covering member and degree, respectively; rank zero and empty schemes are included. No finiteness or invertibility assumption on $R$ or $X$ is imposed.
